comparisons.name: app-light-debug.apk
comparisons.reason: the multidex partition differeth between two builds of the same clean tree: the six classes*.dex entries disagree in content and in size (46364 vs 46316, 98708 vs 98440 bytes) while the other 188 entries are byte-identical; the debug variant dexeth through the incremental build cache, so the class-to-dex partition is not a function of the sources alone, and byte-reproducibility of an unsigned debug APK is NOT claimed

note: An unsigned binary is rarely byte-identical across runs: zip entry timestamps, build metadata and debug paths all move. Every divergence here carrieth its cause or is counted unexplained; no divergence is ever averaged into a pass.
